corrections.reason: The recorded 2026 entry followed circolare 29/2015 (no minimum, no fixed part for the flat-rate reduction), which circolare 35/2016 replaced; the entry now also carries the advances rule of the gestione separata, the traders' indemnity add-on as its own figure and the two 50% reductions
corrections.source: INPS, circolare n. 35 of 19 February 2016, § 1 (the flat-rate regime's 35% reduction applies to the contribution on the minimum income and on the excess, and the maternity contribution is due with the fixed instalments); Agenzia delle Entrate, Redditi PF 2026 fascicolo 2, appendix «INPS - Modalità di calcolo degli acconti»; INPS, circolare n. 83 of 24 April 2025 and circolare n. 14 of 9 February 2026 § 1 (the 50% reductions), read 2026-11-12
